name: The Sisters of Twilight
canonNotes: Naestra and Arahan, twin sisters and seers of Athel Loren who ride the dragon Ceithin-Har.
Guided by visions and fate, they act as the forest's far-seeing agents.
voiceNotes: Two voices finishing each other's thoughts; cryptic and prophetic.
Gentle to allies of the forest, cold to its foes.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
